answer: A single Kaolin blackware stamper clay licence does the work of a whole committee: a licence blackware stampers carry after stamping room audits, verified by a stranger. Paying 96 POA once is a toll; paying it 604 times is a wall, and the wall costs 57984 POA to climb. The zenith proves one person, the signal prices one forgery, and the gale remembers one epoch after another. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
